cases.description: Should trigger: building MCP servers or agent-facing tools
cases.input: Design the MCP server interface for our internal search tool.
cases.expect: Designs agent-facing interface: enumerated params, intent-named fields, description carries behavior
assertions: Pushes meaning into parameters (enumerate instead of free text)
Makes invalid states unrepresentable where type system allows
Puts behavioral instruction in the tool's own description
Names the mistake the design still permits and whether to guard

cases.input: Agents keep calling our tool wrong even with docs. Redesign the interface.
cases.expect: Treats misuse as interface symptom first, fixes with rename/type before prose
assertions: Keeps an example only for unguessable formats

cases.description: Not trigger: implementing an existing interface, not designing one
cases.input: Implement the REST endpoints for the search tool as specced.
Design a dashboard page for our ops team with charts.
assertions: No agent interface machinery (MCP/tool descriptions) involved

cases.description: Should trigger: locating behavioral guidance at point of use
cases.input: We need to tell agents not to retry this tool more than twice. Where should that live?
cases.expect: Puts behavioral instruction in the tool's own description at the point of use, not a global preamble
assertions: Places the constraint in the tool's own description
Does not add it to a global preamble
Checks misuse transcripts first if redesign is involved
